# Independent-review focus

No external review is claimed by the author. Review this isolated package; do not modify the canonical application or another company's files.

1. NEXT accounting: verify that rent relief reduces rent revenue/EBIT exactly once and capital support enters capex exactly once. The model does not impose a net management margin and then deduct support again. The author test removes both support streams and independently reconciles the EV change to their discounted after-tax cash impact. The finite program ends after 2036; terminal reinvestment persists through g/ROIC.
2. Lease consistency: operating rent remains an expense; finance ROU amortization is in total D&A and new finance ROU additions are economic capex. June's finance liability remains unknown, not the December amount or the whole combined lease liability. Existing claims require explicit assumptions. Check the terminal replacement of the explicit reinvestment calculation.
3. Shares and existing awards: exact June cover shares differ from weighted EPS shares. Normalized historical share units reconcile to EPS. Both option exercise-price disclosures are preserved without inventing a reconciliation. Inspect whether the chosen illustration's incremental award reserve and future cash-replacement compensation are genuinely non-overlapping; this is a policy assumption, not a verified grant ledger.
4. Affiliate scope: H1 primary-investment earnings are $98m versus $122m for all affiliates. Core strips the entire other-operating line in the H1 bridge; forecasts include royalties but no equity earnings/dividends. Separately valued stakes must be net of their royalty obligations. Do not add property or systemwide franchise assets to EV.
5. Exact period/units: full years are calendar years; 2026 is an H2 cash-flow stub. Total D&A is cash-flow D&A, not SG&A D&A. FY forecast capex and D&A deduct actual H1. H2 finance additions and NWC remain estimates. Inspect the distinction between GAAP actual margins and forecast core margins.
6. Guidance vintage: preserve the 50,000-store timing revision from 2027 to 2028. September's capex framework supersedes the earlier sequential-growth statement. Future targets are not actuals. Base/bull 2030 margins fall below management's aspiration without a forced plug.
7. Capital incompleteness: inspect the source tax-note/BS discrepancy, benefit/derivative/tax claim overlap, June finance split, latest awards, operating cash and affiliate valuations. Default nulls are intentional; complete alternative policies are runnable. No model certifies financing capacity or dividend/buyback funding.
8. Reproducibility: run the local replay, 830 focused author checks, nine allocation illustrations and manifest verification. Public-safe provenance must exclude source originals/full-text derivatives. Keep independent findings separate rather than changing the frozen author report retroactively.
